mapDescription: Original camera-to-board homography from the eleven-capture Duck Hunt replay. Camera corners [(552,208),(1537,214),(1510,974),(561,960)] map to the unit board; matrix generated by production Homography.FromFourPoints. Full original camera pixels, no crop or resampling.

fixtures.note: Independently viewed pink laser on the old vector duck wing near camera (1047,625). Original expected-positive capture; baseline and conditional candidate retain exactly the same weighted colour centroid. The component has 29 colour pixels,8 strong magenta signal pixels,and1 clipped pixel. An unconditional one-third coherence rule loses this genuine faint dot; one-quarter for components containing clipped pixels preserves it.
